# Building the CIS Readiness Index {#building-readiness-index}

```{ojs}
thresholds = await FileAttachment("/data/cis/thresholds.json").json();

// One entry per indicator: its key in thresholds.json, the name to show it under,
// and how many decimals it reads at. Tables and exports build their columns from
// this, so an indicator is named the same everywhere and a label change is one edit.
//TODO: labels are English-only, as are this section's other widget strings — they
// want keys in data/cis/text/<locale>.json.
CIS_INDICATORS = new Object({
  cis_readiness_index: { threshold: "cis_dfci", label: "CIS Readiness", decimals: 3 },
  wstation_density: { threshold: "WeatherStation_idx", label: "Weather Station", decimals: 3 },
  "cloud-coverage_meanannual": { threshold: "OpticalAvailability_idx", label: "Cloud Cover", decimals: 3 },
  "cv-precipitation_agreement": { threshold: "Precipitation variability agreement", label: "Satellite Agreement", decimals: 1 },
  "short-term_frcst_skill": { threshold: "ShortTerm_idx", label: "Short-term Skill", decimals: 3 },
  seasonal_frcst_skill: { threshold: "LongTerm_idx", label: "Long-term Skill", decimals: 3 },
});

thresholdIndicatorByField = new Object(
  Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(CIS_INDICATORS).map(([field, i]) => [field, i.threshold]),
  ),
);

// A "<label> (Raw)" / "<label> (Class)" pair per indicator. Tables want the value
// formatted; a CSV export wants the number itself, so `format` chooses. Set
// `withClass: false` for indicators that have no threshold band to show.
S11_INDICATORS = ["wstation_density", "cloud-coverage_meanannual"]

indicatorColumns = (row, fields, { format = true, withClass = true } = {}) =>
  Object.fromEntries(
    fields.flatMap((field) => {
      const { label, decimals } = CIS_INDICATORS[field];
      const pairs = [
        [`${label} (Raw)`, format ? fmt(row[field], decimals) : row[field]],
      ];
      if (withClass) {
        pairs.push([
          `${label} (Class)`,
          classifyThreshold(field, row[field], row),
        ]);
      }
      return pairs;
    }),
  );

// Which bivariate cells rank highest, and the string key naming each tier.
bivariatePriority = thresholds.bivariatePriority

thresholdAdminLevel = (rowOrLevel = currentAdminLevel) => {
  if (typeof rowOrLevel === "number") return `admin${rowOrLevel}`;
  if (rowOrLevel?.admin2_name != null) return "admin2";
  if (rowOrLevel?.admin1_name != null) return "admin1";
  return "admin0";
};

thresholdRules = (field, rowOrLevel = currentAdminLevel) =>
  thresholds[thresholdAdminLevel(rowOrLevel)].indicators[
    thresholdIndicatorByField[field]
  ];

classifyThreshold = (field, value, rowOrLevel = currentAdminLevel) => {
  const numericValue = Number(value);
  if (value == null || Number.isNaN(numericValue)) return "No data";

  const rules = thresholdRules(field, rowOrLevel);
  const match = rules.find((rule, index) =>
    "value" in rule
      ? numericValue === rule.value
      : numericValue >= rule.min &&
        (index === rules.length - 1
          ? numericValue <= rule.max
          : numericValue < rule.max),
  );

  return match?.category ?? "No data";
};

classificationBand = (category) => {
  const label = String(category).toLowerCase();
  if (label.includes("no data")) return "no data";
  if (label.includes("weak") || label.includes("low")) return "low";
  if (label.includes("strong") || label.includes("high")) return "high";
  return "moderate";
};

classificationScale = (field, colors) => ({
  type: "categorical",
  domain: thresholdRules(field).map((rule) => rule.category),
  range: colors,
  label: "Classification",
});
```

```{ojs}
/**
 * Interpret forecast skill based on both short-term and long-term RPSS scores
 * RPSS (Ranked Probability Skill Score) measures forecast quality:
 *   > 0.6 = Good/reliable forecasts
 *   < 0.4 = Poor/unreliable forecasts
 *
 * Delta is long minus short, the same direction the maps and charts use, so a
 * negative delta is skill decaying with lead time.
 *
 * @param {number} shortTerm - Short-term (1-2 month) forecast RPSS
 * @param {number} longTerm - Long-term (11-12 month) forecast RPSS
 * @returns {object} Interpretation text and CIS implication
 */
classifyForecastSkill = (shortTerm, longTerm) => {
  if (shortTerm == null || longTerm == null)
    return { interpretation: "No data", implication: "Insufficient data" };

  // Same sign convention as the maps and charts: long minus short, so a positive
  // delta means skill improves with lead time.
  const delta = longTerm - shortTerm;

  // Case 1: Both horizons perform well - ideal for CIS deployment
  if (shortTerm > 0.6 && longTerm > 0.6) {
    return {
      interpretation: "Reliable forecasts at both horizons",
      implication: "Scale CIS for advisories + finance",
    };
  }
  // Case 2: Good short-term but poor long-term - limit to operational use
  else if (shortTerm > 0.6 && longTerm < 0.4 && delta < -0.2) {
    return {
      interpretation: "Rapid loss of skill",
      implication: "Limit use to short-term planning",
    };
  }
  // Case 3: Both horizons perform poorly - use historical averages instead
  else if (shortTerm < 0.4 && longTerm < 0.4) {
    return {
      interpretation: "Weak predictability",
      implication: "Use climatology / caution",
    };
  }
  // Case 4: Mixed results - blend forecasts with historical data
  else {
    return {
      interpretation: "Uncertain but usable",
      implication: "Blend with historical averages",
    };
  }
};
```

```{ojs}
// currentAdminLevel, currentBoundaries and adminKey all come from adminView in
// notebook.qmd, which resolves them once from the selection.
filteredData = {
  const bind = createSqlBindings();
  const adminWhere = sqlAdminWhere(
    { admin0: selectedAdmin0, admin1: selectedAdmin1 },
    bind,
    { iso3: iso3Set },
  );

  const rows = await db.query(
    `
    SELECT *
    FROM cis_data
    WHERE ${adminWhere}
  `,
    bind.params,
  );

  return rows;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Joins filteredData onto whatever boundaries the current selection resolves to
// and adds the one label every map's tooltip wants. Scoping and the level rule
// live in helpers/adminBoundaries.js; the join is the shared mergeDataToBoundaries.
// The only per-map difference is which columns to read off the joined row, so that
// is the argument: `fields(dataRow)` gets undefined where a boundary has no match.
buildLevelFeatures = (fields, data = filteredData, view = adminView) => {
  const geoData = mergeDataToBoundaries({
    boundaries: view.boundaries,
    data,
    boundaryKey: (feature) => view.adminKey(feature.properties),
    dataKey: view.adminKey,
  });

  return geoData.features.map((feature) => {
    const p = feature.properties;

    return {
      ...feature,
      properties: {
        ...p,
        // Precomputed so tooltips do not rebuild it on every hover. Deeper than
        // adminDisplayName: this one keeps the country at admin 2.
        regionName:
          view.level === 0
            ? p.admin0_name
            : view.level === 1
              ? `${p.admin1_name}, ${p.admin0_name}`
              : `${p.admin2_name}, ${p.admin1_name}, ${p.admin0_name}`,
        ...fields(p.data),
      },
    };
  });
}

```

```{ojs}
// Breadcrumb navigation
breadcrumb = {
  const parts = [];
  
  // Show SSA if no admin0 selected
  if (selectedAdmin0.length === 0) {
    parts.push('Sub-Saharan Africa');
  } else {
  if (selectedAdmin0.length === 1) parts.push(selectedAdmin0[0]);
    else parts.push(`${selectedAdmin0.length} countries`);
  }
  
  if (selectedAdmin1.length === 1) parts.push(selectedAdmin1[0]);
  else if (selectedAdmin1.length > 1) parts.push(`${selectedAdmin1.length} admin1 regions`);
  
  if (selectedAdmin2.length === 1) parts.push(selectedAdmin2[0]);
  else if (selectedAdmin2.length > 1) parts.push(`${selectedAdmin2.length} admin2 regions (highlighted)`);
  
  return parts.join(' → ');
}
```

```{ojs}
// Prepare data for Section 1.1 maps
s11MapData = {
  const features = buildLevelFeatures((d) => ({
    weatherStation: d?.["wstation_density"],
    cloudCover: d?.["cloud-coverage_meanannual"],
    weatherStationClass: d
      ? classifyThreshold("wstation_density", d["wstation_density"], d)
      : "No data",
    cloudCoverClass: d
      ? classifyThreshold("cloud-coverage_meanannual", d["cloud-coverage_meanannual"], d)
      : "No data",
  }));

  // Show the no-data features rather than an empty map if nothing joined.
  const withData = features.filter(
    (f) => f.properties.weatherStation != null || f.properties.cloudCover != null,
  );
  return {
    type: "FeatureCollection",
    features: withData.length ? withData : features,
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
// Section 1.1 Dynamic Insight

s11Insight = {
  const insightData = onlySelectedAtLevel(filteredData);
  
  const avgWeatherStation = d3.mean(insightData, d => d["wstation_density"]);
  const avgCloudCover = d3.mean(insightData, d => d["cloud-coverage_meanannual"]);
  
  const wsClass = classificationBand(classifyThreshold("wstation_density", avgWeatherStation));
  const ccClass = classificationBand(classifyThreshold("cloud-coverage_meanannual", avgCloudCover));
  
  // Without the first arm an all-missing selection reported "moderate capacity".
  const capacity =
    wsClass === "no data" || ccClass === "no data"
      ? "no data"
      : wsClass === "high" && ccClass === "high"
        ? "high"
        : wsClass === "low" || ccClass === "low"
          ? "low"
          : "moderate";
  
  return tmpl(nbText.insights.stationDensity, {
    area: breadcrumb,
    density: avgWeatherStation?.toFixed(3),
    clearSky: avgCloudCover?.toFixed(3),
    capacity,
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
// Section 1.3 Controls
viewof s13ViewType = Inputs.radio(["Map", "Chart", "Table"], {
  label: nbText.viewTypeLabel,
  value: "Map"
})

viewof s13SortBy = {
  // Only show sort-by when Chart or Table view is selected
  if (s13ViewType === "Map") {
    const input = Inputs.radio(["Short-term skill", "Long-term skill", "Difference (Δ)"], {
      label: nbText.sortByLabel,
      value: "Short-term skill"
    });
    input.style.display = "none";
    return input;
  }
  return Inputs.radio(["Short-term skill", "Long-term skill", "Difference (Δ)"], {
    label: nbText.sortByLabel,
    value: "Short-term skill"
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
// Section 1.3 Map Data Preparation
s13MapData = {
  const features = buildLevelFeatures((d) => {
    const shortTerm = d ? d["short-term_frcst_skill"] : null;
    const longTerm = d ? d["seasonal_frcst_skill"] : null;
    return {
      shortTerm,
      longTerm,
      delta: shortTerm != null && longTerm != null ? longTerm - shortTerm : null,
    };
  }).filter(
    (f) => f.properties.shortTerm != null || f.properties.longTerm != null,
  );

  return { type: "FeatureCollection", features };
}
```

```{ojs}
// Prepare data for Section 1.3
s13Data = {
  const data = filteredData.map(d => {
    const shortTerm = d["short-term_frcst_skill"];
    const longTerm = d["seasonal_frcst_skill"];
    const classification = classifyForecastSkill(shortTerm, longTerm);
    
    const adminName = adminDisplayName(d);
    
    return {
      admin: adminName,
      shortTerm: shortTerm,
      longTerm: longTerm,
      delta: shortTerm != null && longTerm != null ? longTerm - shortTerm : null,
      interpretation: classification.interpretation,
      implication: classification.implication
    };
  }).filter(d => d.shortTerm != null || d.longTerm != null);
  
  // Sort data
  if (s13SortBy === "Short-term skill") { //TODO: We can use bulit in OJS plot fn instead
    data.sort((a, b) => (b.shortTerm || 0) - (a.shortTerm || 0));
  } else if (s13SortBy === "Long-term skill") {
    data.sort((a, b) => (b.longTerm || 0) - (a.longTerm || 0));
  } else {
    // Sort by delta - most positive to most negative
    data.sort((a, b) => (b.delta || 0) - (a.delta || 0));
  }
  
  return data;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Section 1.3 Map/Chart/Table
{
  if (s13ViewType === "Map") {
    // Three panels over the same features, differing only in the column they
    // colour by, the scale, and the labels.
    const panels = [
      {
        key: "shortTerm",
        title: "Short-term Forecast Skill (1–2 mo)",
        label: "Short-term",
        color: { type: "linear", domain: [0, 1], scheme: "RdYlGn", label: "RPSS" },
      },
      {
        key: "longTerm",
        title: "Long-term Forecast Skill (11–12 mo)",
        label: "Long-term",
        color: { type: "linear", domain: [0, 1], scheme: "RdYlGn", label: "RPSS" },
      },
      {
        key: "delta",
        title: "Difference (Long − Short)",
        label: "Difference",
        color: {
          type: "diverging",
          domain: [-0.5, 0.5],
          scheme: "RdBu",
          label: "Δ (Long − Short)",
        },
      },
    ];

    return htl.html`<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(350px, 1fr)); gap: 20px; margin-top: 20px;">
      ${panels.map(
        ({ key, title, label, color }) => htl.html`<div style="text-align: center;">
        <h4 style="margin-bottom: 10px; font-size: 14px;">${title}</h4>
        ${makeChoropleth({
          features: s13MapData,
          width: 400,
          height: 450,
          fill: (d) => d.properties[key],
          color,
          channels: {
            region: { label: "Region", value: (d) => d.properties.regionName },
            [key]: { label, value: (d) => fmt(d.properties[key], 3) },
          },
          tooltip: { region: true, [key]: true },
          adminHighlight,
        })}
      </div>`,
      )}
    </div>`;
  } else if (s13ViewType === "Chart") {

    // Prepare data in the format expected by the chart
    const data = s13Data.map(d => {
      const short = d.shortTerm != null ? parseFloat(d.shortTerm) : null;
      const long = d.longTerm != null ? parseFloat(d.longTerm) : null;
      const delta = short != null && long != null ? long - short : null;
      
      return {
        country: d.admin,
        short: short,
        long: long,
        delta: delta,
      };
    }).filter(d => d.short != null || d.long != null);
    
    // Descending on the selected metric; delta sorts most positive to most negative.
    const sortKey =
      { "Short-term skill": "short", "Long-term skill": "long" }[s13SortBy] ??
      "delta";
    const sorted = data.sort((a, b) => (b[sortKey] || 0) - (a[sortKey] || 0));
    
    // Flatten data: each geography gets 3 entries (Short-term, Long-term, Delta)
    const longData = sorted.flatMap((d) => [
      {
        country: d.country,
        metric: "Short-term RPSS (1–2 mo)",
        value: d.short
      },
      {
        country: d.country,
        metric: "Long-term RPSS (11–12 mo)",
        value: d.long
      },
      {
        country: d.country,
        metric: "Δ (Long − Short)",
        value: d.delta
      }
    ]).filter(d => d.value != null);
    
    // Calculate responsive height based on number of geographies
    const geographyCount = sorted.length;
    // Height is dynamic: 20px per region to prevent label overlap, min 400px
    const height = Math.max(400, geographyCount * 20);
    
    // Get the ordered list of countries from sorted data
    const countryOrder = sorted.map(d => d.country);
    
    // Calculate margin based on longest geography name
    const maxNameLength = Math.max(...countryOrder.map(name => name.length), 0);
    const marginLeft = Math.max(200, maxNameLength * 8); // At least 200px, or 8px per character
    
    // Wrap chart in scrollable container to handle many regions
    const chart = Plot.plot({
      style: chartStyle,
      marginLeft: marginLeft,
      marginTop: 40,
      marginBottom: 60,
      width: width,
      height: height,
      y: { axis: null },
      x: { 
        grid: true,
        axis: "top",
        label: "RPSS or Δ"
      },
      fy: { 
        padding: 0,  // Set padding to 0 to reduce spacing between bars
        label: null,
        domain: countryOrder // Use pre-sorted order to maintain sort
      },
      color: { 
        domain: [
          "Short-term RPSS (1–2 mo)",
          "Long-term RPSS (11–12 mo)",
          "Δ (Long − Short)"
        ],
        range: ["#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833"],
        legend: true
      },
      marks: [
        // X-axis at bottom
        Plot.axisX({ 
          anchor: "bottom", 
          label: "RPSS or Δ"
        }),
        Plot.barX(longData, {
          x: "value",
          y: "metric",
          fill: "metric",
          fy: "country",
          sort: {
            y: null,
            color: null
          },
          tip: true
        }),
        Plot.ruleX([0], { stroke: "black" })
      ]
    });
    
    // Return chart in scrollable container with fixed max-height
    return htl.html`<div style="max-height: 600px; overflow-y: auto; border: 1px solid #eee; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px;">
      ${chart}
    </div>`;
  } else {
    const tableData = s13Data.map(d => ({
      "Admin Name": d.admin,
      "Short-term": fmt(d.shortTerm, 3),
      "Long-term": fmt(d.longTerm, 3),
      "Delta": fmt(d.delta, 3),
      "Interpretation": d.interpretation,
      "CIS Implication": d.implication
    }));
    
    return filterableDataTable(tableData, {
      rows: 20
    });
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
// Prepare data for Section 1.4
s14MapData = {
  const features = buildLevelFeatures((d) => ({
    cisReadiness: d?.["cis_readiness_index"],
    cisReadinessClass: d
      ? classifyThreshold("cis_readiness_index", d["cis_readiness_index"], d)
      : "No data",
    weatherStation: d?.["wstation_density"],
    weatherStationClass: d
      ? classifyThreshold("wstation_density", d["wstation_density"], d)
      : "No data",
    cloudCover: d?.["cloud-coverage_meanannual"],
    cloudCoverClass: d
      ? classifyThreshold("cloud-coverage_meanannual", d["cloud-coverage_meanannual"], d)
      : "No data",
    precipAgreement: d ? parseFloat(d["cv-precipitation_agreement"]) : null,
    precipAgreementClass: d
      ? classifyThreshold("cv-precipitation_agreement", d["cv-precipitation_agreement"], d)
      : "No data",
    shortTerm: d?.["short-term_frcst_skill"],
    longTerm: d?.["seasonal_frcst_skill"],
  })).filter((f) => f.properties.cisReadiness != null);

  return { type: "FeatureCollection", features };
}
```

```{ojs}
// Section 1.4 Visualization
{
  if (s14ViewType === "Map") {
    return makeChoropleth({
      features: s14MapData,
      width: width,
      height: 600,
      fill: d => d.properties.cisReadiness,
      color: {
        type: "linear",
        domain: d3.extent(s14MapData.features, d => d.properties.cisReadiness),
        scheme: "RdYlGn",
        label: "CIS Readiness Index"
      },
      channels: {
        region: {
          label: "Region",
          value: (d) => d.properties.regionName
        },
        cisReadiness: {
          label: "CIS Readiness",
          value: (d) => d.properties.cisReadiness != null
            ? `${d.properties.cisReadiness.toFixed(3)} (Relative to SSA)`
            : "N/A"
        },
        class: {
          label: "Classification",
          value: (d) => d.properties.cisReadinessClass
        },
        weatherStation: {
          label: "Weather Stn",
          value: (d) => d.properties.weatherStationClass
        },
        cloudCover: {
          label: "Cloud Cover",
          value: (d) => d.properties.cloudCoverClass
        },
        precipAgreement: {
          label: "Precip Agree",
          value: (d) => d.properties.precipAgreementClass
        }
      },
      tooltip: {
        region: true,
        cisReadiness: true,
        class: true,
        weatherStation: true,
        cloudCover: true,
        precipAgreement: true
      },
      baseMarkOptions: {
        fillOpacity: 1
      },
      adminHighlight
    });
  } else if (s14ViewType === "Table") {
    const tableData = filteredData
      .filter(d => d["cis_readiness_index"] != null)
      .map((d) => ({
        "Admin Name": adminDisplayName(d),
        ...indicatorColumns(d, [
          "cis_readiness_index",
          "wstation_density",
          "cloud-coverage_meanannual",
          "cv-precipitation_agreement",
        ]),
        ...indicatorColumns(
          d,
          ["short-term_frcst_skill", "seasonal_frcst_skill"],
          { withClass: false },
        ),
      }));
    
    return filterableDataTable(tableData, { // TODO: Why this tabe go ... when rest horizontal scroll
      sort: "CIS Readiness (Raw)",
      reverse: true,
    })

  } else {
    const heatmapData = filteredData
      .filter(d => d["cis_readiness_index"] != null)
      .map(d => {
      const adminName = adminDisplayName(d);
      
      return {
        country: adminName,
        "Weather Stations": d["wstation_density"],
        "Cloud Cover": d["cloud-coverage_meanannual"],
        "Precip Agreement": parseFloat(d["cv-precipitation_agreement"]) / 4, // Normalize to 0-1
        "Short-term Forecast": d["short-term_frcst_skill"],
        "Long-term Forecast": d["seasonal_frcst_skill"],
        "CIS Readiness": d["cis_readiness_index"]
      };
    });
    
    // Sort by CIS Readiness (descending)
    heatmapData.sort((a, b) => (b["CIS Readiness"] || 0) - (a["CIS Readiness"] || 0));
    
    const sortedCountries = heatmapData.map(d => d.country);
    const indicators = ["Weather Stations", "Cloud Cover", "Precip Agreement", "Short-term Forecast", "Long-term Forecast", "CIS Readiness"];
    
    // Rotated -45 degrees, a label needs roughly its length again in vertical
    // space. The indicator names repeat top and bottom, so both margins get it.
    const cellHeight = 25;
    const axisPad = Math.max(
      60,
      Math.round(Math.max(...indicators.map((i) => i.length)) * 6),
    );
    const marginLeft = Math.max(
      180,
      Math.max(...sortedCountries.map((name) => name.length), 0) * 7,
    );
    // The colour legend is a sibling element above the svg, not drawn inside it,
    // so the frame budgets for the cells and the two axes only.
    const height = Math.max(
      400,
      heatmapData.length * cellHeight + axisPad * 2,
    );
    
    // Flatten data for heatmap (long format)
    const longData = heatmapData.flatMap(row => 
      indicators.map(indicator => ({
        country: row.country,
        indicator: indicator,
        value: row[indicator]
      }))
    ).filter(d => d.value != null);
    
    // Rendered at full height rather than inside a scroll box: the height is one
    // row per unit, so a window only hid the size of it and scrolled the x axis
    // out of view. This is behind a view toggle, not the default.
    return htl.html`<div style="width: 100%; overflow-x: auto;">
      ${Plot.plot({
        style: chartStyle,
        width: width,
        height: height,
        marginLeft: marginLeft,
        marginTop: axisPad,
        marginBottom: axisPad,
        marginRight: 20,
        x: {
          label: null,
          domain: indicators,
          axis: null, // drawn explicitly below, top and bottom
        },
        y: {
          label: null,
          domain: sortedCountries
        },
        color: {
          type: "linear",
          scheme: "RdYlBu",
          reverse: true,  // Red = high, Blue = low
          legend: true,
          label: "Value"
        },
        marks: [
          // Repeated on both edges so the indicator names stay readable at the
          // bottom of a plot that is one row per admin unit.
          Plot.axisX({ anchor: "top", tickRotate: -45 }),
          Plot.axisX({ anchor: "bottom", tickRotate: -45 }),
          Plot.cell(longData, {
            x: "indicator",
            y: "country",
            fill: "value",
            tip: {
              fontSize: 14,
              format: {
                fill: d => fmt(d, 3)
              }
            }
          }),
          Plot.text(longData, {
            x: "indicator",
            y: "country",
            text: d => d.value != null ? d.value.toFixed(2) : "",
            fill: d => d.value > 0.5 ? "white" : "black",
            fontSize: 9
          })
        ]
      })}
    </div>`;
  }
}
```
